1.consolidated_definition: Pez de agua dulce y salada de hasta 70 cm de longitud, de cuerpo ancho y corto, cabeza plana, aletas radiadas y coloración pardusca, con una raya oscura horizontal a lo largo de todo el cuerpo; es comestible. Eleotridae, Dormitator maculatus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Freshwater and brackish fish, reaching a length of up to 70 cm, with a broad and short body, flat head, radiated fins, and mottled coloration, featuring a dark horizontal stripe along the entire body; it is edible. Family Eleotridae, Dormitator maculatus.
